subtitle: Rosary & Catholic Prayers
promotionalText: Pray the Rosary on iPhone and Apple Watch. Lux Fidelium keeps your place and your count, so your attention can rest on the prayer.

description.text: Lux Fidelium helps you pray the Rosary, or any prayer, wherever your day finds you. It keeps your place and your count, so your attention can rest on the prayer.
On Apple Watch, Pray Mode turns the whole screen into one button. Tap to move to the next prayer. Each prayer has its own feel on your wrist, so you know where you are without looking.
On iPhone, Pray Mode shows each prayer in large type with one big Continue button, easy to follow with your phone set down beside you. Your place stays on the Lock Screen while you pray.
When your iPhone and Apple Watch are together, they pray as one: a step on either moves both. Each also works fully on its own, with no account to set up.
The prayers you know by heart

items: The Rosary, with the day's mysteries chosen for you
Rosary How To, for anyone learning to pray it
The Apostles' and Nicene Creeds, the Angelus, the Memorare and the Hail Holy Queen
The Litanies of the Sacred Heart, St. Joseph and Loreto
Pray in English, Spanish or Latin, with some prayers in Greek, and choose the language for each prayer
Choose what's on Home, and pin the prayers you pray most
See the day in the Church's year each time you open the app
Read at the text size you need, in a serif or a plain typeface

description.text: No ads, no accounts and no tracking. What the app records stays on your devices and in your own iCloud.

Praying, browsing and syncing are free. Lux Fidelium Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription that adds your full prayer statistics and a choice of color themes: $0.99 (US) per month or $9.99 (US) per year, with a free trial for new subscribers of two weeks on the monthly plan and one month on the yearly plan. Subscriptions can be shared with your family through Family Sharing. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.
